      transform: scale(1.06);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(2,131,141,0.2);
      border-color: var(--teal-mid);
    }

    .topic-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .carousel-arrows {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--teal);
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .carousel-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    /* =============================================
       HEALTH TOOLS
    ============================================= */
    .tools-section {
      background: var(--off-white);
      padding: 64px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .nutrition-hub-header {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal) 0%, #04a8b4 100%);
      padding: 28px 28px 24px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-header::after {
      content: '🥗';
      position: absolute;
      right: 20px;
      bottom: -8px;
      font-size: 60px;
      opacity: 0.3;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-eyebrow {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-desc {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 16px;
      padding: 9px 18px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: 100px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-cta:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.32); }

    .nutrition-hub-tools {
      padding: 16px 28px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1px;
      background: var(--gray-100);
    }

    .nutrition-tool-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-item:hover { background: var(--teal-light); }

    .nutrition-tool-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--teal-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .nutrition-tool-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-top: 1px;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-arrow {
      margin-left: auto;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-arrow svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    /* Drug/Care tools */
    .care-tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .care-tool-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .care-tool-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--teal-mid);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .care-tool-icon {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 22px;
    }

    .care-tool-icon.blue { background: #e8f4ff; }
    .care-tool-icon.green { background: var(--teal-light); }
    .care-tool-icon.amber { background: #fff5e0; }
    .care-tool-icon.purple { background: #f3eeff; }

    .care-tool-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .care-tool-desc {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.5;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .care-tool-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--teal);
    }

    .care-tool-cta svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

    /* =============================================
       RECOMMENDED READS
    ============================================= */
    .recommended-reads {
      padding: 64px 0;
    }

    .reads-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gray-100);
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .reads-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .reads-tab {
      padding: 10px 18px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
      position: relative;
      bottom: -2px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    }

    .reads-tab:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    .reads-tab.active {
      color: var(--teal);
      border-bottom-color: var(--teal);
    }

    .reads-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .read-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .read-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .read-card-img {
      height: 180px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light) 0%, var(--gray-100) 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 52px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .read-card-img::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 100%);
    }

    .read-card-body {
      padding: 18px;
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .read-card-category {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.7px;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .read-card-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .read-card-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .read-card-meta-dot {
      width: 3px;
      height: 3px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .read-card-reviewed {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--teal);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .read-card-reviewed svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; }

    /* =============================================
       TRUST PILLARS
    ============================================= */
    .trust-section {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--charcoal) 0%, #2d2829 100%);
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .trust-section::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='80' height='80' viewBox='0 0 80 80' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none'%3E%3Ccircle cx='40' cy='40' r='1' fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E") repeat;
    }

    .trust-header-center {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .trust-eyebrow {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.2px;
      color: var(--teal-mid);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .trust-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      letter-spacing: -0.6px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .trust-pillars-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .trust-pillar {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 28px 24px;
      transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }

    .trust-pillar:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-color: rgba(2,131,141,0.4);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .trust-pillar-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: rgba(2,131,141,0.25);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: 24px;
    }

    .trust-pillar-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .trust-pillar-desc {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* =============================================
       FEATURED PROGRAMS
    ============================================= */
    .featured-programs {
      padding: 64px 0;
    }

    .programs-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .program-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .program-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .program-card-img {
      height: 160px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 48px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .program-card-img-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fce4e4, #f8bbd0); }
    .program-card-img-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3f2fd, #bbdefb); }
    .program-card-img-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9, #c8e6c9); }
    .program-card-img-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff3e0, #ffe0b2); }

    .program-card-label {
      position: absolute;
      top: 10px;
      left: 10px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: var(--charcoal-light);
    }

    .program-card-body {
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .program-card-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .program-card-link {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .program-card-link svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; }

    /* =============================================
       LATEST VIDEOS
    ============================================= */
    .latest-videos {
      background: var(--off-white);
      padding: 64px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .videos-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .video-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }

    .video-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .video-thumb {
      position: relative;
      height: 148px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .video-thumb-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e0f7e9, #b2dfdb); }
    .video-thumb-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fce4ec, #f8bbd0); }
    .video-thumb-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3f2fd, #bbdefb); }
    .video-thumb-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8e1, #ffecb3); }

    .video-thumb-emoji { font-size: 40px; }

    .play-btn {
      position: absolute;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    }

    .video-card:hover .play-btn {
      transform: scale(1.08);
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .play-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--teal); margin-left: 2px; }

    .video-duration {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      color: white;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .video-card-body {
      padding: 14px 16px;
    }

    .video-category {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .video-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* =============================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================= */
    .site-footer {
      background: var(--charcoal);
      padding: 56px 0 0;
    }

    .footer-newsletter {
      background: rgba(2,131,141,0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(2,131,141,0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 36px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 400px;
      gap: 40px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .footer-newsletter-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .footer-newsletter-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .footer-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .footer-input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 11px 16px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 13px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.15s;
    }

    .footer-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
    .footer-input:focus { border-color: var(--teal); }

    .btn-footer-signup {
      padding: 11px 20px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: 100px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .btn-footer-signup:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); }

    .footer-main {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      padding-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .footer-brand .logo-text { color: var(--white); }
    .footer-brand .logo-text span { color: var(--teal-mid); }

    .footer-brand-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 20px;
    }

    .footer-social-link {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    }

    .footer-social-link:hover {
      background: rgba(2,131,141,0.3);
      border-color: var(--teal);
    }

    .footer-links-wrap {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .footer-link {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      transition: color 0.15s;
      padding: 2px 4px;
    }

    .footer-link:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }

    .footer-link-dot {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      line-height: 1;
      margin: 0 2px;
    }

    .footer-legal {
      padding: 24px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }

    .footer-legal p {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* =============================================
       RESPONSIVE
    ============================================= */
    @media (max-width: 1100px) {
      .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 280px; gap: 28px; }
      .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .trust-pillars-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .tools-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .nutrition-hub-card { max-width: 100%; }
      .care-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
      .topic-card { width: calc((100% - 60px) / 4); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-visual { display: none; }
      .trending-articles { gap: 8px 0; }
      .trending-article { border-right: none; margin-right: 0; padding: 4px 0; width: 100%; }
      .trending-inner { flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
      .trending-label { border-right: none; padding-right: 0; margin-right: 0; }
      .footer-newsletter { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; }
      .footer-main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .reads-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .care-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-list, .header-actions { display: none; }
      .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; margin-left: auto; }
      .site-logo { flex: 1; }
      .hero-title { font-size: 28px; }
      .section-title { font-size: 20px; }
      .trust-title { font-size: 22px; }
      .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .reads-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .topic-card { width: calc((100% - 40px) / 3); min-width: 110px; }
      .topic-img-wrap { width: 90px; height: 90px; font-size: 32px; }
      .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }
      .tools-section { padding: 40px 0; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container { padding: 0 16px; }
      .section-padding { padding: 44px 0; }
      .programs-grid, .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .care-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .trust-pillars-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .reads-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-cta-group { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
    }

    /* =============================================
       ANIMATIONS
    ============================================= */
    @keyframes fadeInUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .animate-in {
      animation: fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out both;
    }

    .animate-delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
    .animate-delay-2 { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
    .animate-delay-3 { animation-delay: 0.3s; }

<script>
  // =============================================
  // NAVIGATION MEGA-MENUS
  // =============================================
  function toggleMenu(id) {
    const item = document.getElementById(id);
    const btn = item.querySelector('.nav-btn');
    const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');

    // Close all
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item.open').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('open');
      el.querySelector('.nav-btn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });

    // Open clicked if it was closed
    if (!isOpen) {
      item.classList.add('open');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    }
  }

  // Close on outside click
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('.nav-item')) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item.open').forEach(el => {
        el.classList.remove('open');
        el.querySelector('.nav-btn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    }
  });

  // Close on Escape
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item.open').forEach(el => {
        el.classList.remove('open');
        el.querySelector('.nav-btn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    }
  });

  // =============================================
  // MOBILE NAVIGATION
  // =============================================
  function toggleMobileNav() {
    document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('open');
    document.getElementById('mobilePanel').classList.toggle('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = document.getElementById('mobilePanel').classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
  }

  function closeMobileNav() {
    document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.remove('open');
    document.getElementById('mobilePanel').classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  // =============================================
  // CAROUSEL
  // =============================================
  let carouselOffset = 0;

  function carouselNext() {
    const track = document.getElementById('topicsCarousel');
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.topic-card');
    const cardWidth = cards[0].offsetWidth + 20; // gap
    const maxOffset = (cards.length - getVisibleCards()) * cardWidth;
    carouselOffset = Math.min(carouselOffset + cardWidth, maxOffset);
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${carouselOffset}px)`;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s ease-out';
  }

  function carouselPrev() {
    const track = document.getElementById('topicsCarousel');
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.topic-card');
    const cardWidth = cards[0].offsetWidth + 20;
    carouselOffset = Math.max(carouselOffset - cardWidth, 0);
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${carouselOffset}px)`;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s ease-out';
  }

  function getVisibleCards() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w < 480) return 2;
    if (w < 768) return 3;
    if (w < 1100) return 4;
    return 5;

              </span>
            ` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>
    `).join('');
  }

  let currentTab = 'top-reads';

  function switchTab(btn, category) {
    if (currentTab === category) return;
    currentTab = category;

    // Update tab states
    document.querySelectorAll('.reads-tab').forEach(t => {
      t.classList.remove('active');
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

    // Animate content swap
    const grid = document.getElementById('readsGrid');
    grid.classList.add('fading');
    setTimeout(() => {
      grid.innerHTML = renderArticles(category);
      grid.classList.remove('fading');
    }, 180);
  }

  // Initial render
  document.getElementById('readsGrid').innerHTML = renderArticles('top-reads');

  // =============================================
  // NEWSLETTER FORMS
  // =============================================
  function handleNewsletter(event, successId, formId) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = document.getElementById(formId);
    const success = document.getElementById(successId);
    form.style.display = 'none';
    success.classList.add('show');
  }

  // =============================================
  // SCROLL REVEAL
  // =============================================
  const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach((entry, i) => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        }, 60 * (Array.from(entry.target.parentElement?.querySelectorAll?.('.reveal') || []).indexOf(entry.target) || 0));
        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, {
    threshold: 0.08,
    rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px'
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));
</script>

      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .link-view-all {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--teal);
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: gap 0.15s;
    }

    .link-view-all:hover { gap: 8px; }
    .link-view-all svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    .topic-card {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      width: calc((100% - 80px) / 5);
      min-width: 140px;
    }

    .topic-img-wrap {
      width: 120px;
      height: 120px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 3px solid var(--white);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light), var(--teal-mid));
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 40px;
    }

    .topic-card:hover .topic-img-wrap {
      transform: scale(1.06);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(2,131,141,0.2);
      border-color: var(--teal-mid);
    }

    .topic-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .carousel-arrows {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--teal);
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .carousel-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    /* =============================================
       HEALTH TOOLS
    ============================================= */
    .tools-section {
      background: var(--off-white);
      padding: 64px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .nutrition-hub-header {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal) 0%, #04a8b4 100%);
      padding: 28px 28px 24px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-header::after {
      content: '🥗';
      position: absolute;
      right: 20px;
      bottom: -8px;
      font-size: 60px;
      opacity: 0.3;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-eyebrow {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-desc {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 16px;
      padding: 9px 18px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: 100px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-cta:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.32); }

    .nutrition-hub-tools {
      padding: 16px 28px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1px;
      background: var(--gray-100);
    }

    .nutrition-tool-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-item:hover { background: var(--teal-light); }

    .nutrition-tool-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--teal-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .nutrition-tool-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-top: 1px;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-arrow {
      margin-left: auto;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-arrow svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    /* Drug/Care tools */
    .care-tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .care-tool-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .care-tool-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--teal-mid);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .care-tool-icon {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 22px;
    }

    .care-tool-icon.blue { background: #e8f4ff; }
    .care-tool-icon.green { background: var(--teal-light); }
    .care-tool-icon.amber { background: #fff5e0; }
    .care-tool-icon.purple { background: #f3eeff; }

    .care-tool-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .care-tool-desc {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.5;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .care-tool-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--teal);
    }

    .care-tool-cta svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

    /* =============================================
       RECOMMENDED READS
    ============================================= */
    .recommended-reads {
      padding: 64px 0;
    }

    .reads-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gray-100);
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .reads-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .reads-tab {
      padding: 10px 18px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
      position: relative;
      bottom: -2px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    }

    .reads-tab:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    .reads-tab.active {
      color: var(--teal);
      border-bottom-color: var(--teal);
    }

    .reads-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .read-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .read-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .read-card-img {
      height: 180px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light) 0%, var(--gray-100) 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 52px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .read-card-img::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 100%);
    }

    .read-card-body {
      padding: 18px;
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .read-card-category {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.7px;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .read-card-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .read-card-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .read-card-meta-dot {
      width: 3px;
      height: 3px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .read-card-reviewed {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--teal);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .read-card-reviewed svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; }

    /* =============================================
       TRUST PILLARS
    ============================================= */
    .trust-section {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--charcoal) 0%, #2d2829 100%);
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .trust-section::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='80' height='80' viewBox='0 0 80 80' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none'%3E%3Ccircle cx='40' cy='40' r='1' fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E") repeat;
    }

    .trust-header-center {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .trust-eyebrow {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.2px;
      color: var(--teal-mid);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .trust-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      letter-spacing: -0.6px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .trust-pillars-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .trust-pillar {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 28px 24px;
      transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }

    .trust-pillar:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-color: rgba(2,131,141,0.4);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .trust-pillar-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: rgba(2,131,141,0.25);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: 24px;
    }

    .trust-pillar-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .trust-pillar-desc {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* =============================================
       FEATURED PROGRAMS
    ============================================= */
    .featured-programs {
      padding: 64px 0;
    }

    .programs-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .program-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .program-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .program-card-img {
      height: 160px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 48px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .program-card-img-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fce4e4, #f8bbd0); }
    .program-card-img-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3f2fd, #bbdefb); }
    .program-card-img-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9, #c8e6c9); }
    .program-card-img-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff3e0, #ffe0b2); }

    .program-card-label {
      position: absolute;
      top: 10px;
      left: 10px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: var(--charcoal-light);
    }

    .program-card-body {
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .program-card-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .program-card-link {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .program-card-link svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; }

    /* =============================================
       LATEST VIDEOS
    ============================================= */
    .latest-videos {
      background: var(--off-white);
      padding: 64px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .videos-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .video-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }

    .video-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .video-thumb {
      position: relative;
      height: 148px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .video-thumb-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e0f7e9, #b2dfdb); }
    .video-thumb-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fce4ec, #f8bbd0); }
    .video-thumb-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3f2fd, #bbdefb); }
    .video-thumb-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8e1, #ffecb3); }

    .video-thumb-emoji { font-size: 40px; }

    .play-btn {
      position: absolute;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    }

    .video-card:hover .play-btn {
      transform: scale(1.08);
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .play-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--teal); margin-left: 2px; }

    .video-duration {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      color: white;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .video-card-body {
      padding: 14px 16px;
    }

    .video-category {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .video-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* =============================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================= */
    .site-footer {
      background: var(--charcoal);
      padding: 56px 0 0;
    }

    .footer-newsletter {
      background: rgba(2,131,141,0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(2,131,141,0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 36px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 400px;
      gap: 40px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .footer-newsletter-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .footer-newsletter-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .footer-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .footer-input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 11px 16px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 13px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.15s;
    }

    .footer-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
    .footer-input:focus { border-color: var(--teal); }

    .btn-footer-signup {
      padding: 11px 20px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: 100px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .btn-footer-signup:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); }

    .footer-main {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      padding-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .footer-brand .logo-text { color: var(--white); }
    .footer-brand .logo-text span { color: var(--teal-mid); }

    .footer-brand-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 20px;
    }

    .footer-social-link {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    }

    .footer-social-link:hover {
      background: rgba(2,131,141,0.3);
      border-color: var(--teal);
    }

    .footer-links-wrap {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .footer-link {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      transition: color 0.15s;
      padding: 2px 4px;
    }

    .footer-link:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }

    .footer-link-dot {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      line-height: 1;
      margin: 0 2px;
    }

    .footer-legal {
      padding: 24px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }

    .footer-legal p {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* =============================================
       RESPONSIVE
    ============================================= */
    @media (max-width: 1100px) {
      .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 280px; gap: 28px; }
      .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .trust-pillars-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .tools-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .nutrition-hub-card { max-width: 100%; }
      .care-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
      .topic-card { width: calc((100% - 60px) / 4); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-visual { display: none; }
      .trending-articles { gap: 8px 0; }
      .trending-article { border-right: none; margin-right: 0; padding: 4px 0; width: 100%; }
      .trending-inner { flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
      .trending-label { border-right: none; padding-right: 0; margin-right: 0; }
      .footer-newsletter { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; }
      .footer-main { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .reads-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .care-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-list, .header-actions { display: none; }
      .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; margin-left: auto; }
      .site-logo { flex: 1; }
      .hero-title { font-size: 28px; }
      .section-title { font-size: 20px; }

      .reads-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .topic-card { width: calc((100% - 40px) / 3); min-width: 110px; }
      .topic-img-wrap { width: 90px; height: 90px; font-size: 32px; }
      .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }
      .tools-section { padding: 40px 0; }
    }

      .container { padding: 0 16px; }
      .section-padding { padding: 44px 0; }
      .programs-grid, .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .care-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .trust-pillars-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .reads-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-cta-group { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
    }

    /* =============================================
       ANIMATIONS
    ============================================= */
    @keyframes fadeInUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .animate-in {
      animation: fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out both;
    }

    .animate-delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
    .animate-delay-2 { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
    .animate-delay-3 { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
    .animate-delay-4 { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

    /* Scroll reveal */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(24px);
      transition: opacity 0.55s ease-out, transform 0.55s ease-out;
    }

    .reveal.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    /* =============================================
       MISC
    ============================================= */
    .divider {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--gray-100);
    }

    /* Tab content transitions */
    .reads-content { transition: opacity 0.2s; }
    .reads-content.fading { opacity: 0; }

    /* Mobile nav overlay */
    .mobile-nav-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      z-index: 900;

<script>
  // =============================================
  // NAVIGATION MEGA-MENUS
  // =============================================
  function toggleMenu(id) {
    const item = document.getElementById(id);
    const btn = item.querySelector('.nav-btn');
    const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');

    // Close all
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item.open').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.remove('open');
      el.querySelector('.nav-btn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });

    // Open clicked if it was closed
    if (!isOpen) {
      item.classList.add('open');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    }
  }

  // Close on outside click
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('.nav-item')) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item.open').forEach(el => {
        el.classList.remove('open');
        el.querySelector('.nav-btn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    }
  });

  // Close on Escape
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item.open').forEach(el => {
        el.classList.remove('open');
        el.querySelector('.nav-btn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });
    }
  });

  // =============================================
  // MOBILE NAVIGATION
  // =============================================
  function toggleMobileNav() {
    document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('open');
    document.getElementById('mobilePanel').classList.toggle('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = document.getElementById('mobilePanel').classList.contains('open') ? 'hidden' : '';
  }

  function closeMobileNav() {
    document.getElementById('mobileOverlay').classList.remove('open');
    document.getElementById('mobilePanel').classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  // =============================================
  // CAROUSEL
  // =============================================
  let carouselOffset = 0;

  function carouselNext() {
    const track = document.getElementById('topicsCarousel');
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.topic-card');
    const cardWidth = cards[0].offsetWidth + 20; // gap
    const maxOffset = (cards.length - getVisibleCards()) * cardWidth;
    carouselOffset = Math.min(carouselOffset + cardWidth, maxOffset);
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${carouselOffset}px)`;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s ease-out';
  }

  function carouselPrev() {
    const track = document.getElementById('topicsCarousel');
    const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.topic-card');
    const cardWidth = cards[0].offsetWidth + 20;
    carouselOffset = Math.max(carouselOffset - cardWidth, 0);
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${carouselOffset}px)`;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s ease-out';
  }

  function getVisibleCards() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    if (w < 480) return 2;
    if (w < 768) return 3;
    if (w < 1100) return 4;
    return 5;
  }

  // Reset on resize
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    carouselOffset = 0;

      { emoji: '🌸', category: 'Skin Care', title: "Beginner's Guide to Sensitive Skin: Where to Start", time: '7 min read', reviewed: true },
      { emoji: '🧴', category: 'Skin Care', title: 'SPF 50 Sunscreens That Won\'t Leave White Cast', time: '5 min read', reviewed: true },
      { emoji: '🌿', category: 'Eczema', title: 'Eczema Solutions: Knowledge for Self-Care', time: '8 min read', reviewed: true },
      { emoji: '✨', category: 'Anti-Aging', title: 'Retinol vs. Retinoids: What\'s the Difference?', time: '6 min read', reviewed: true },
      { emoji: '💧', category: 'Hydration', title: 'How to Build the Perfect Moisturizing Routine', time: '5 min read', reviewed: false },
      { emoji: '☀️', category: 'Sun Care', title: 'What Dermatologists Want You to Know About SPF', time: '4 min read', reviewed: true },
    ]
  };

  function renderArticles(category) {
    const articles = articleData[category] || articleData['top-reads'];
    return articles.map(article => `
      <article class="read-card">
        <div class="read-card-img">${article.emoji}</div>
        <div class="read-card-body">
          <div class="read-card-category">${article.category}</div>
          <h3 class="read-card-title">${article.title}</h3>
          <div class="read-card-meta">
            <span>${article.time}</span>
            ${article.reviewed ? `
              <span class="read-card-meta-dot"></span>
              <span class="read-card-reviewed">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline></svg>
                Medically reviewed
              </span>
            ` : ''}
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>
    `).join('');
  }

  let currentTab = 'top-reads';

  function switchTab(btn, category) {
    if (currentTab === category) return;
    currentTab = category;

    // Update tab states
    document.querySelectorAll('.reads-tab').forEach(t => {
      t.classList.remove('active');
      t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    });
    btn.classList.add('active');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

    // Animate content swap
    const grid = document.getElementById('readsGrid');
    grid.classList.add('fading');
    setTimeout(() => {
      grid.innerHTML = renderArticles(category);
      grid.classList.remove('fading');
    }, 180);
  }

  // Initial render
  document.getElementById('readsGrid').innerHTML = renderArticles('top-reads');

  // =============================================
  // NEWSLETTER FORMS
  // =============================================
  function handleNewsletter(event, successId, formId) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = document.getElementById(formId);
    const success = document.getElementById(successId);
    form.style.display = 'none';
    success.classList.add('show');
  }

  // =============================================
  // SCROLL REVEAL
  // =============================================
  const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach((entry, i) => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
        }, 60 * (Array.from(entry.target.parentElement?.querySelectorAll?.('.reveal') || []).indexOf(entry.target) || 0));
        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, {
    threshold: 0.08,
    rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px'
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));
</script>

</body>

      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    }

    .btn-newsletter {
      padding: 13px 24px;
      background: var(--coral);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: 100px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
    }

    .btn-newsletter:hover {
      background: var(--coral-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .newsletter-privacy {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    /* =============================================
       HEALTH TOPICS CAROUSEL
    ============================================= */
    .section-padding { padding: 64px 0; }

    .section-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .section-eyebrow {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(22px, 2.5vw, 30px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .link-view-all {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--teal);
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: gap 0.15s;
    }

    .link-view-all:hover { gap: 8px; }
    .link-view-all svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; }

    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      overflow: hidden;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    .topic-card {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      width: calc((100% - 80px) / 5);
      min-width: 140px;
    }

    .topic-img-wrap {
      width: 120px;
      height: 120px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 3px solid var(--white);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light), var(--teal-mid));
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 40px;
    }

    .topic-card:hover .topic-img-wrap {
      transform: scale(1.06);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(2,131,141,0.2);
      border-color: var(--teal-mid);
    }

    .topic-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .carousel-arrows {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, transform 0.1s;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--teal);
      background: var(--teal-light);
      color: var(--teal);
      transform: scale(1.05);
    }

    .carousel-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }

    /* =============================================
       HEALTH TOOLS
    ============================================= */
    .tools-section {
      background: var(--off-white);
      padding: 64px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 380px 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .nutrition-hub-header {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal) 0%, #04a8b4 100%);
      padding: 28px 28px 24px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-header::after {
      content: '🥗';
      position: absolute;
      right: 20px;
      bottom: -8px;
      font-size: 60px;
      opacity: 0.3;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-eyebrow {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-desc {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 16px;
      padding: 9px 18px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: 100px;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .nutrition-hub-cta:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.32); }

    .nutrition-hub-tools {
      padding: 16px 28px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1px;
      background: var(--gray-100);
    }

    .nutrition-tool-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      transition: background 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-item:hover { background: var(--teal-light); }

    .nutrition-tool-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--teal-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
    }

    .nutrition-tool-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      margin-top: 1px;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-arrow {
      margin-left: auto;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .nutrition-tool-arrow svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }

    /* Drug/Care tools */
    .care-tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .care-tool-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .care-tool-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: var(--teal-mid);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .care-tool-icon {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 22px;
    }

    .care-tool-icon.blue { background: #e8f4ff; }
    .care-tool-icon.green { background: var(--teal-light); }
    .care-tool-icon.amber { background: #fff5e0; }
    .care-tool-icon.purple { background: #f3eeff; }

    .care-tool-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .care-tool-desc {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      line-height: 1.5;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .care-tool-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--teal);
    }

    .care-tool-cta svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }

    /* =============================================
       RECOMMENDED READS
    ============================================= */
    .recommended-reads {
      padding: 64px 0;
    }

    .reads-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gray-100);
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .reads-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .reads-tab {
      padding: 10px 18px;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
      position: relative;
      bottom: -2px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    }

    .reads-tab:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    .reads-tab.active {
      color: var(--teal);
      border-bottom-color: var(--teal);
    }

    .reads-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .read-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .read-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .read-card-img {
      height: 180px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal-light) 0%, var(--gray-100) 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 52px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .read-card-img::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 100%);
    }

    .read-card-body {
      padding: 18px;
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .read-card-category {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.7px;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .read-card-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .read-card-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .read-card-meta-dot {
      width: 3px;
      height: 3px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-200);
    }

    .read-card-reviewed {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--teal);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .read-card-reviewed svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; }

    /* =============================================
       TRUST PILLARS
    ============================================= */
    .trust-section {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--charcoal) 0%, #2d2829 100%);
      padding: 72px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .trust-section::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='80' height='80' viewBox='0 0 80 80' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none'%3E%3Ccircle cx='40' cy='40' r='1' fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E") repeat;
    }

    .trust-header-center {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .trust-eyebrow {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1.2px;
      color: var(--teal-mid);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .trust-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      letter-spacing: -0.6px;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .trust-pillars-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .trust-pillar {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 28px 24px;
      transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }

    .trust-pillar:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-color: rgba(2,131,141,0.4);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .trust-pillar-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: rgba(2,131,141,0.25);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: 24px;
    }

    .trust-pillar-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .trust-pillar-desc {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* =============================================
       FEATURED PROGRAMS
    ============================================= */
    .featured-programs {
      padding: 64px 0;
    }

    .programs-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .program-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
      cursor: pointer;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .program-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
    }

    .program-card-img {
      height: 160px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 48px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .program-card-img-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fce4e4, #f8bbd0); }
    .program-card-img-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3f2fd, #bbdefb); }
    .program-card-img-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8f5e9, #c8e6c9); }
    .program-card-img-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff3e0, #ffe0b2); }

    .program-card-label {
      position: absolute;
      top: 10px;
      left: 10px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: var(--charcoal-light);
    }

    .program-card-body {
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .program-card-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .program-card-link {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--teal);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .program-card-link svg { width: 11px; height: 11px; }

    /* =============================================
       LATEST VIDEOS
    ============================================= */
    .latest-videos {
      background: var(--off-white);
      padding: 64px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
    }

    .videos-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .video-card {
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-100);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
    }

    .video-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .video-thumb {
      position: relative;
      height: 148px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .video-thumb-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e0f7e9, #b2dfdb); }
    .video-thumb-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fce4ec, #f8bbd0); }
    .video-thumb-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3f2fd, #bbdefb); }
    .video-thumb-4 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff8e1, #ffecb3); }

    .video-thumb-emoji { font-size: 40px; }

    .play-btn {
      position: absolute;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
      transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    }

    .video-card:hover .play-btn {
      transform: scale(1.08);
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .play-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--teal); margin-left: 2px; }

    .video-duration {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      color: white;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .video-card-body {
      padding: 14px 16px;
    }

    .video-category {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .video-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--charcoal);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* =============================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================= */
    .site-footer {
      background: var(--charcoal);
      padding: 56px 0 0;
    }

    .footer-newsletter {
      background: rgba(2,131,141,0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(2,131,141,0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 36px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 400px;
      gap: 40px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .footer-newsletter-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .footer-newsletter-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .footer-form {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .footer-input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 11px 16px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 100px;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 13px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.15s;
    }

    .footer-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
    .footer-input:focus { border-color: var(--teal); }

    .btn-footer-signup {
      padding: 11px 20px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: 100px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .btn-footer-signup:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); }

    .footer-main {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
      gap: 64px;
      padding-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .footer-brand .logo-text { color: var(--white); }
    .footer-brand .logo-text span { color: var(--teal-mid); }

    .footer-brand-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 20px;
    }

    .footer-social-link {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    }

    .footer-social-link:hover {
      background: rgba(2,131,141,0.3);
      border-color: var(--teal);
    }

    .footer-links-wrap {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .footer-link {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      transition: color 0.15s;
      padding: 2px 4px;
    }

    .footer-link:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); }

    .footer-link-dot {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      line-height: 1;
      margin: 0 2px;
    }

    .footer-legal {
      padding: 24px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }

    .footer-legal p {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* =============================================
       RESPONSIVE
    ============================================= */

      .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

      .nutrition-hub-card { max-width: 100%; }
      .care-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
      .topic-card { width: calc((100% - 60px) / 4); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-visual { display: none; }
      .trending-articles { gap: 8px 0; }
      .trending-article { border-right: none; margin-right: 0; padding: 4px 0; width: 100%; }

      .reads-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .care-tools-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-list, .header-actions { display: none; }
      .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex; margin-left: auto; }
      .site-logo { flex: 1; }
      .hero-title { font-size: 28px; }
      .section-title { font-size: 20px; }

      .programs-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .videos-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .reads-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .topic-card { width: calc((100% - 40px) / 3); min-width: 110px; }
      .topic-img-wrap { width: 90px; height: 90px; font-size: 32px; }
      .newsletter-form { flex-direction: column; }
      .tools-section { padding: 40px 0; }
    }

      .trust-pillars-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
